description: Degradation — an athlete with no HRV, no power meter, no swim data (07-ACCEPTANCE.md §B F15; 03-ALGORITHM.md §14)

input.note: HR is present because the athlete owns a watch; the three named absences are HRV, power and swim data.

readiness.note: Weights redistribute across whatever inputs exist (§10.1); no HRV and no sleep device leaves wellness + completion.

expected.note: No crash, no null targets: every session gets at least an RPE band, which needs no sensor.
